tail_vignette_placements.alt: Pencil drawing of A plain recording-room door seen close, slightly open, its handle lightly held by an anonymous hand.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: Choosing the next work.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Pencil drawing of A plain photographic negative sleeve partly withdrawn from its protective folder, with empty translucent pockets.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: A trace still worth following.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Pencil drawing of Two unoccupied ordinary stools facing slightly different directions, one at the edge of an indicated performance floor and the other beyond it.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: On either side of the performance.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Pencil drawing of an open classroom doorway with a plain chair just inside.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: A classroom makes room for performance.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Pencil drawing of Two coat hooks with different plain everyday shirts hanging beside each other, sleeves just overlapping.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: Company between performances.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Pencil drawing of A simple studio lamp casts a soft triangular patch of light into an empty space.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: Helping the work take shape.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Pencil drawing of hands holding an imagined film strip for inspection.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: Looking closely at another person’s work.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: An imagined doorway opens into a quiet courtyard.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: A household threshold, imagined.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Pencil drawing of Five mismatched empty chairs form a loose, incomplete semicircle, one pulled slightly forward.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: After the screening, a conversation.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Unlettered publicity sheets lie beside the edge of a screen.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: Bringing a film to its audience.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Pencil drawing of two hands making separate L-shaped framing gestures.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: Another way to frame the story.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Pencil drawing of a small movie camera on a low three-legged support.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: Making space for a younger viewer.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Pencil drawing of A small unbranded television antenna above a simple dark screen edge.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: A film finds another route home.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Pencil drawing of An unbranded insulated delivery bag rests with its straps loosely folded.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: A working life beyond the screen.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Three positions of a paper bird suggest the making of movement between exposures.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: Between one position and the next.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Plain headphones beside a folded blank sheet suggest listening and a film conceived as a letter.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: Listening for what remains.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Three bicycles beside an imagined open doorway, recalling arrivals for a story discussion.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: Arriving for a conversation.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: A hand supports a box of unlettered booklets and an envelope, suggesting material being passed on.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: Something kept, ready to be passed on.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Pencil drawing of Three separated traces: a torn blank newspaper margin, the edge of a plain sound-recording disc sleeve and a small empty photo corner.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: Following what remains.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Pencil drawing of two hands holding the rolled lower edge of a projection screen.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: Ready for another audience.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Pencil drawing of a closed book with a bookmark extending into a small leaf-like flourish.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: Reading opens another question.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Two ordinary chairs, with a closed folder on one seat.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: Waiting, within a household.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Pencil drawing of Several overlapping loose page corners with small erasure smudges and pencil revision marks, one corner lifted.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: Time between one draft and the next.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Pencil drawing of A lightly folded mosquito net hangs over a simple support, its open weave fading into white.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: Care continues beyond one journey.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Pencil drawing of A plain clock face without numerals beside a small unbranded wireless remote control, drawn at unequal angles with generous white space.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: A story beyond its scheduled hour.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Pencil drawing of a hand offering a small screen to another open hand.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: A story reaches another viewer.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: Pencil drawing of Two plain ticket stubs overlap at their torn edges beside the faint outline of an open auditorium doorway.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: An audience for the next story.

tail_vignette_placements.alt: An imagined boat carries a closed case, recalling the journeys needed to take films to audiences.
tail_vignette_placements.caption: The journey before the screening.
